cases.name: pack_assign
cases.eval: epc_industry_seed_packs($GLOBALS['db_link']); $a=epc_industry_assign_pack($GLOBALS['db_link'],'acme','fashion',7); $b=epc_industry_assign_pack($GLOBALS['db_link'],'acme','fashion',9); $c=epc_industry_assign_pack($GLOBALS['db_link'],'acme','electronics',7); $d=epc_industry_assign_pack($GLOBALS['db_link'],'beta','fashion',1); $rows=epc_industry_tenant_packs($GLOBALS['db_link'],'acme'); foreach($rows as &$r){ unset($r['applied_at']); $r['id']=(int)$r['id']; $r['applied_by']=(int)$r['applied_by']; } usort($rows,function($x,$y){ return strcmp($x['pack_key'],$y['pack_key']); }); $fleet=epc_industry_fleet_stats($GLOBALS['db_link']); foreach($fleet as &$f){ $f['tenants']=(int)$f['tenants']; } return array($a,$b,$c,$d,$rows,$fleet);

$c6=epc_promo_create($pdo,'acme',array('name'=>'Old','code'=>'OLD','type'=>'percentage','value'=>10,'start_date'=>'2010-01-01','end_date'=>'2011-01-01','priority'=>1)); $c7=epc_promo_create($pdo,'acme',array('name'=>'Tier','code'=>'TIER','type'=>'tiered','value'=>8,'start_date'=>'2020-01-01','end_date'=>'2099-12-31','priority'=>0)); } $apply=array(epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','NOPE',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','save10',40), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','SAVE10',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','SAVE10',1000), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','FLAT',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','SHIP',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','BOGO',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','TIER',100), epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','OLD',100)); $first=epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','SAVE10',100,9); $rec=epc_promo_record_usage($pdo,(int)$first['promotion_id'],'acme',9,'SO1',(float)$first['discount']); $again=epc_promo_apply($pdo,'acme','SAVE10',100,9);
